name: chrome-mcp
description: Chrome MCP - Control Chrome browser via Model Context Protocol

scripts.add-to-claude: claude mcp add chrome -- bun run "$(pwd)/server/src/server.ts"
scripts.setup: cd server && bun install --frozen-lockfile && cd .. && bun run pair
scripts.check:extension: node --check extension/background.js && node --check extension/page-monitor.js && node --check extension/popup.js
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run check:extension
